# Showcase: more catalogues, the shop and the rest of the app, after 10_kurotoon set things up
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 4
tapx Home
tap "Add sources"
sleep 8
tap Search
type Webtoons.com
sleep 4
shot ext_webtoons
tapx Install
sleep 12
tapx Install
sleep 20
key 123
sh input keyevent 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67
type Asura
sleep 4
shot ext_asura
tapx Install
sleep 12
tapx Install
sleep 20
shot ext_installed
back
back
tapx Browse
sleep 3
shot sources_list
tap Webtoons.com
sleep 10
shot webtoons_popular
tapx Latest
sleep 8
shot webtoons_latest
tapxy 270 1000
sleep 10
shot webtoons_series
tap "Add to library"
sleep 3
back
back
tap "Asura Scans"
sleep 12
shot asura_popular
tapxy 270 1000
sleep 10
shot asura_series
tap "Add to library"
sleep 3
tap Start
sleep 15
shot asura_reader

sleep 2
shot asura_reader_menu

sleep 3
shot reader_chapter_list
back
back
back
back
back

sleep 3
shot library_full

shot group_by

shot library_by_source
